'''NEK-01''' was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that served the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Sonnos]]. After the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Deggar Feps]] angered Sonnos, NEK-01 was sent to find Feps, and for several days it used reprogrammed droids to track Feps' movements on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. NEK-01 eventually learned that Feps planned to leave Nal Hutta aboard the [[Dartiss-5 Caravel]] ''[[Lost Lady]]'', so it sent [[NEK-072]]&mdash;a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] fitted with a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] and reprogrammed with NEK-01's personality&mdash;to board the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and broadcast a signal calling for nearby [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to destroy the ship on sight. NEK-01 hoped that the ''Lost Lady'' would then be attacked and destroyed, allowing the spy droid to collect the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on Feps.
